comment: The terrain MCP surface a generated project gets once it installs @threenative/terrain. `tools` is set-equal to the tool table version 0.1.0 serves. Regenerate with `pnpm tsx scripts/capture-terrain-mcp-tools.ts`.

out.description: Relative directory that must not exist yet.

descriptions.terrain_generate: Cook one editable starter terrain kit (forest, coastal, alpine, desert or tundra) into a world.glb.
descriptions.terrain_patch: Apply editor commands (upsert, update, remove, move, toggle) to a terrain recipe and return the edited recipe.
